fix: Run opening and eligible closing/post-create focus synchronously after visibility and disabled state changes, preserving every existing eligibility and current-session guard. No delayed focus callback remains in this module.

coverage: A held opening frame cannot take newer Email focus or redirect typed input.
A held closing frame cannot take newer Search focus.
Opening focuses Name during the action and creates the invitation with the intended identity.
Close and reopen cannot leave stale focus callbacks affecting the new form.

focusedExistingInvitations.sourceCommitMeaning: Base HEAD at the time; the focus fix and regression were active as uncommitted changes. The subsequent full gate uses committed sourceAfter.

limitations: The original full-run failures had no focus instrumentation. The isolated creation workflow reproduced the same second-dialog symptom with a direct invalid-input/no-POST discriminator, and the held-frame experiment independently proved its mechanism.
The first-dialog failure in the original full run and older historical invitation timeouts are not individually attributed by this evidence; their causes remain unconfirmed.
Only disposable local backend/browser fixtures were used; no hosted fixture or live data was created.
privacy: No request or response bodies, private links, authentication headers, cookies or credentials are retained. Trace values record only field lengths, controlled role/Department values, booleans and sanitized local stack locations.
